title: Final Coefficients
description: Essential Criteria: Provide the correct values for a_v, a_s, a_e, a_a, and a_p with appropriate units.

title: Binding Energy Terms
description: Important Criteria: Explain the significance of each term in the binding energy equation B(Z, A) and their physical meaning.

title: Volume and Surface Energy
description: Important Criteria: Justify why B_v is proportional to A and B_s to A^{2/3}, including a brief explanation of nuclear structure.

title: Coulomb Energy Explanation
description: Important Criteria: Describe how the Coulomb energy term B_e relates to Z and A, including its dependence on nuclear radius.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for mistakes in the signs or factors when explaining the terms of the binding energy.
